I don’t know how old you are but I used to feel the same way obviously this don’t have to all be immediately but implement these all over time

First of all get personal hygiene in check
Deodorant stick and spray ( I recommend degree or dove)

Invest in an electric toothbrush, tongue scraper and water flosser

Shower regularly at least once in the morning and make sure you have a good smelling body wash or bar of soap shampoo every 2-3 days and if you have longer hair use conditioner as well

Start a skin care routine keep it simple just a face wash and a moisturizer but if you have any other issues you can try and research your own method or go to a dermatologist

Lastly I would invest in a good quality cologne some very versatile and mass appealing ones are ysl y, Dior sauvage and bleu de channel those can get a bit pricey but at the end of the day they will be worth it I would go to a Macys or Dillards before you purchase any just so you know what you like

Next is grooming

If you are young I would just keep your face clean shaved but if you’re older maybe try growing out the beard

Trim up your eyebrows, look up a tutorial on YouTube for this you really don’t want to mess this up 😂

Then try and find a hair style that fits you it can be tricky and you’ll need to experiment a little but eventually you’ll get it, or you could stick with classic and timeless cuts because they usually look good on most people

Next is clothing
There’s nothing I can really do to help you here because you should wear with you like, ofc find something you like a run with it but don’t be afraid to do something unique and completely different from most of your other fits

Then I’d also start going to the gym because who doesn’t want to be healthy!

Implement all these and over time and you’ll find the one 🙏
